trust: server owns cars, ball, fuel, collisions, goals and match clock; clients send controls
resume: connection loss ends the anonymous seat; a new connection is a new generation

client.input: I SEQ THROTTLE STEER FLAGS PAINT CLOCK HEARD
client.sequence: positive, strictly newer than accepted and pending; latest controls step on the server beat
client.heard: last complete state tick; a partial or rejected state is not acknowledged
client.reported_body: refused; legacy c frames cannot move an authoritative car

server.state: S TICK SEAT GENERATION ACK ECHO PHASE PHASE_MS CLOCK_MS BLUE MAGENTA KICKS PLAYERS;ENTRIES
server.removal: a body absent from a complete snapshot is removed; partial snapshots retain the prior world
server.units: positions and velocities: thousandths; quaternion: millionths; paint and life: whole; fuel: thousandths
server.replication: complete snapshots; every row is absolute (BACK 0)
server.identity: a new connection advances its car's life; KICKS identifies a kickoff discontinuity; stale snapshots cannot erase a successor
server.baseline: this small-room profile selects absolute rows; only complete snapshots are applied or acknowledged

presentation: authoritative car snapshots; no self-asserted transform or replay of rejected controls
legacy: the published unversioned c/s profile remains a separate reported-car/server-ball hybrid and does not qualify as authoritative
